rows.label: tlk70000070_01_msg0002
rows.name:
What's that? You want to know
how to get to the desert?

rows.label: tlk70000070_01_msg0003
rows.name:
First, leave the village away from
Orunato Mountain Path and cross
Braying Canyon.

rows.label: tlk70000070_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Come out of the canyon and the
Dana Desert's right there.

rows.label: tlk70000070_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Well, see you. There isn't much in
this village, but come by once in a
while.
